_comment: Provenance for the WebHTV build of Libmpv.xcframework. IOS-POC-17I-1. .github/workflows/ios-libmpv-build.yml is the only thing that reads this file outside its ffmpeg section, which only .github/workflows/ios-ffmpeg-build.yml reads (IOS-POC-26-2b): it rebuilds libmpv alone from the MPVKit 1.0.0 recipe with patches.replacement in place of the upstream 0001 and patches.ao_session after the upstream patches (IOS-POC-24), restores every other library from the zips pinned under dependencies, compares the result with reference, and fails on any hash mismatch or unpinned download. The artifact is a GitHub release asset, not a tracked file.

recipe.build_commit_note: The 1.0.0 binaries were built from build_commit; release_commit only changes Package.swift.
recipe.arguments_note: No enable-gpl, so libmpv is configured with -Dgpl=false: the LGPL MPVKit product, as IOS-POC-9A requires. platform=ios builds ios arm64 plus the arm64 and x86_64 simulator.
recipe.workdir_note: The directory the 1.0.0 release was built in. It appears in libmpv's embedded Configuration string, so building there lets that string be compared byte for byte.

mpv.note: The recipe clones the tag; the workflow fails if its HEAD is not this commit.

replacement.note: Identical to the upstream 0001 except video/out/vulkan/context_moltenvk.m, which now reports layer resizes to mpv. Resize logic from edde746/MPVKit e6b129fdd31347b25d5d862f73f52c23f9e55624, changed as docs/IOS-POC-17I-mpv-resize-libmpv.md records. Applies to mpv v0.41.0 before the upstream 0002 and 0003.

ao_session.note: IOS-POC-24. Copied into the recipe's patch directory as 0004, so the recipe applies it after the upstream 0002 and 0003 (file-name order, git apply). Adds audiounit-skip-session-management to audio/out/ao_audiounit.m and avfoundation-skip-session-management to audio/out/ao_avfoundation.m, both default off: when set, the output leaves the app's AVAudioSession category, mode and activation alone and does not deactivate it on uninit; setPreferredOutputNumberOfChannels stays. Option design after media-kit/libmpv-darwin-build patches/mpv-audiounit-shared-session.patch (159703a6f8b17bdb756d5a687d1ec1e29d90d366, 763a7fa17a1d66ebf29b8fe2fb46c15769d3a12e), changed as docs/IOS-POC-24-audio-session-ownership.md records.

buildscripts.note: Restores FFmpeg from the 1.0.0 FFmpeg-all.zip instead of rebuilding it, so libmpv is the only thing compiled.

dependencies_note: Each zip is placed and unpacked at dist/<name>-<version>/<name>.zip before the build, where the recipe looks for it, so the recipe never downloads. The URLs are the recipe's own except FFmpeg, which is the 1.0.0 release asset. Hashes were taken on 2026-09-25; FFmpeg and reference match the values recorded in IOS-POC-17I.

reference.name: Libmpv.xcframework.zip
reference.note: The upstream artifact the app used until IOS-POC-17I. The workflow requires the ios-arm64 slice of the new build to match it in libmpv's Configuration and enabled-features strings, archive members, defined external symbols and framework files; undefined symbols may differ only through the context_moltenvk member, plus one named toolchain exception: _wcslen, used only by filters_f_hwtransfer.c.o, where Xcode 26's clang turns the loop counting the zero-terminated supported_formats list into wcslen (the same loop on Apple platforms, where wchar_t is a 32-bit int). The user accepted that exception on 2026-09-25 after run 36085068570.

toolchain.note: The recipe runs tools with its own PATH and installs the newest meson from Homebrew if none is on it, so the workflow links the pinned meson into /opt/homebrew/bin and checks the version before building.

artifact.name: Libmpv.xcframework.zip
artifact.note: Published as a prerelease on 2026-09-25 by the workflow run in run; the tag points at release_commit. sha256 is also the SwiftPM checksum and matches the release asset digest and build-manifest.txt. The tag must not match ios-v*-b*, which starts an app release; bump it to publish a new build, because the workflow refuses to replace a published one.

licences.note: Notices for everything the LGPL MPVKit product links on iOS; see third_party/mpv-ios/README.md.

ffmpeg._comment: IOS-POC-26-2b. Inputs of .github/workflows/ios-ffmpeg-build.yml, which rebuilds FFmpeg n8.1.2 with the MPVKit recipe above, the same toolchain and the dependencies above except FFmpeg-all.zip, applies patches.files in file-name order (the recipe's patch/FFmpeg mechanism; the recipe itself has none), stops after FFmpeg (buildscripts), checks Libavutil against reproducibility and Libavformat against reference, and publishes Libavformat.xcframework.zip as artifact. Only Libavformat changes; the app keeps every other FFmpeg library from MPVKit 1.0.0.
ffmpeg.commit_note: The recipe clones the tag; the workflow fails if its HEAD is not this commit. The tag object is 1c2c67c0b9f7f66ab32c19dcf7f227bcd290aa4c.

sources.0003: cherry-pick of FFmpeg e27ad5760c0c8eca7c95bb907dc6e4e62dbf129b, two conflicts resolved (new_playlist keeps n8.1.2's code; the EVENT-only lines from 6d98a9a2e8757d6eb616501ade06877389a31597 are left out)
sources.0005: FongMi/FFmpeg 5805f9364c2e9a5f6ce625c9077b308c3ed4014d, every line identical; hls_timestamp.{c,h} and its test byte-identical to FongMi 177f090e0503b7e013922ca903bde14b1c375f18
sources.0006: WebHTV adaptation of 5805f936: on finished playlists a discontinuity sequence keeps its offset only if its first packet continues its stream (within 1.5 frames and 60 ms, or within 1 s when its playlist position is more than 1 s away) and is otherwise anchored to its playlist position, moved just after the previous packet where that would step video back or overlap audio by a packet or more; for playlists with normalized timestamps the seek discard compares in the packet time base (tag-free playlists keep the upstream comparison). Final round 3 (reviewed as 282f102c07371dd33440588c38447552099ee22b; this export only amends its message); accepted consequences and bounds in docs/IOS-POC-26-engine-switch-position.md

buildscripts.note: Ends the recipe after FFmpeg, so libmpv and its dependencies after FFmpeg are not built in this lane.

reference.name: Libavformat.xcframework.zip
reference.note: The upstream Libavformat the app linked before IOS-POC-26-2b-2, and the rollback target. The ios-arm64 slice of the new build must match it in the configuration and version strings and in every framework file but the binary; archive members may differ only by the added hls_timestamp.o, defined external symbols only by the six ff_hls_timestamp_* functions (four from 5805f936, map_segment and reached from 0006), undefined symbols only through hls.o and hls_timestamp.o. Two named toolchain exceptions, accepted by the user on 2026-09-26 after run 36215262840 (this lane uses Xcode 26.6, the upstream build Xcode 15.4): dashdec.o may call free/realloc where upstream calls libxml2's xmlFree/xmlRealloc, as the Xcode 26.6 SDK's libxml2 headers make it, provided dashdec.o is the only user of those four symbols on each side; and Headers/config.h may differ only in CC_IDENT, HAVE_AS_ARCHEXT_DOTPROD_DIRECTIVE, HAVE_AS_ARCHEXT_I8MM_DIRECTIVE and HAVE_KVTQPMODULATIONLEVEL_DEFAULT, with the values Xcode 26.6 gives (the three probes only reach libavcodec's assembly and VideoToolbox encoder, not libavformat).

reproducibility.name: Libavutil.xcframework.zip
reproducibility.note: No WebHTV change reaches Libavutil, so its ios-arm64 slice must match upstream in configuration, archive members and defined and undefined external symbols: the evidence that this lane reproduces the recipe's FFmpeg build.

artifact.name: Libavformat.xcframework.zip
artifact.note: Published by run 36226970983 from c1bb4d19a750ca0a4ee8c67bdc342e11b67ecad5 (build-manifest.txt with the release; sha256 checked on the downloaded asset). Only the ios-arm64 and ios-arm64_x86_64-simulator slices, as the libmpv lane's Libmpv. ios/Vendor/MPVKit/Package.swift takes url and sha256 as the Libavformat target's url and checksum since IOS-POC-26-2b-2.
